# Check if Lleyton Hewitt faced the same opponent in more than one Master Series finals
# We need to consider rows where outcome is either 'winner' or 'runner - up' (as these are finals)
# Count occurrences of each opponent in these finals
finals_df = df[df['outcome'].isin(['winner', 'runner - up'])]
opponent_counts = finals_df['opponent'].value_counts()
# Check if any opponent appears more than once
answer = not any(opponent_counts > 1)
